name: certkit
description: Browser-local certificate & key toolkit: PFX <-> PEM, certificate/CSR decoding, key match, chain order, DER/JWK inspection. No uploads.

scripts.test: node tests/node-smoke.mjs && node tests/browser-test.mjs && node tests/lib-gate1.mjs
scripts.deploy: cd site && bun run build && cd .. && wrangler pages deploy site/dist --project-name localcertkit
